caption: The drawing depicts a detailed representation of a sculpted eagle with widespread wings. The eagle is colored in gradients of brown and golden brown, with shading used to emphasize the texture and layering of its feathers as well as the form of its head and talons. Its beak is short and curved, shaded a slightly darker brown. The eagle stands atop a rectangular, dark greenish or black base that has reflective highlights. The claws of the eagle grip onto this base, and the entire sculpture is centered on a plain, cream or off-white background. The artist’s name, "Molly H. Badenoch," is written in small letters in the bottom right corner, along with a few additional characters or abbreviations.
title: Eagle: Pilot House Ornament
